sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Strict exclusionary groups breed fervor (Iannaccone); eclectic New Age yields low commitment, opposite of essay.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay's New Agers illustrate diffuse credulity; closure produces deadly spirals, agreeing with Iannaccone; conspirituality.

sharp_disagreements.title: When None Dare Urge Restraint
sharp_disagreements.quote: Any politician who’d said “6,000 deaths is 1/8 the annual US casualties from automobile accidents,” would have been asked to resign the same hour.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Barbara Lee voted against the AUMF and was re-elected; restraint was speakable and survivable.
sharp_disagreements.gist: One of 519, from the safest district, with death threats; the exception confirms the spiral.

sharp_disagreements.title: Crisis of Faith
sharp_disagreements.quote: Many in this world retain beliefs whose flaws a ten-year-old could point out, if that ten-year-old were hearing the beliefs for the first time.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Children are intuitive theists (Kelemen, Evans); a ten-year-old would find God natural.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Secular children classify miracle stories as fiction (Corriveau et al. 2015); teleology bias isn't doctrinal belief.

sharp_disagreements.title: Just Lose Hope Already
sharp_disagreements.quote: If you set out to teach someone how to not turn little mistakes into big mistakes, it’s nearly the same art whether in hedge funds or romance
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Error-avoidance skill is domain-specific and far transfer is weak; a general art is overestimated.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Decision-making competence including sunk-cost resistance predicts outcomes across domains (Bruine de Bruin 2007).

sharp_disagreements.title: No One Can Exempt You From Rationality’s Laws
sharp_disagreements.quote: For example, one finds religious people defending their beliefs by saying, “Well, you can’t justify your belief in science!”
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Essay ignores regress and induction problems; rationalist has only a pragmatic track record, also available to theists.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Track records can be compared; Reichenbach's pragmatic vindication means the regress doesn't level the sides.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Importance of Saying “Oops”
sharp_disagreements.quote: But there is less focus on speed, on giving up the fight as quickly as possible, integrating evidence efficiently so that it only takes a minimum of contrary evidence to destroy your cherished belief.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Bayesian updating prescribes proportionality not speed; over-reaction to flimsy evidence is also common.
sharp_disagreements.gist: 'Minimum' means proportional; conservatism (Phillips & Edwards 1966) shows under-updating is the target error.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Meditation on Curiosity
sharp_disagreements.quote: but if your current belief is 70%, you should be as ready to drop it to 69% as raising it to 71%
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Conservation of expected evidence concerns the mean, not symmetric step sizes; essay misstates the theorem.
sharp_disagreements.gist: With equal step sizes of 69/71, the theorem requires p = 1/2; the sentence is a correct worked instance.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Meditation on Curiosity
sharp_disagreements.quote: But you can’t produce curiosity just by willing it, any more than you can will your foot to feel warm when it feels cold.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Curiosity is reliably induced via information gaps (Loewenstein 1994); essay's practice works but not for its stated reason.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Curiosity isn't willed but procedurally induced; Kang et al. 2009 inverted-U explains why the theorem's practice works.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Proper Use of Doubt
sharp_disagreements.quote: An unresolved doubt is a null-op; it does not turn the wheel, neither forward nor back.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Unresolved doubts as sub-unity credences change action (insurance, margins); contradicts sequence's decision theory.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay's doubt is an open line of inquiry, not a credence; its expected effect is already priced in.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Ritual
sharp_disagreements.quote: the seven major principles and sixty-two specific techniques that were most likely to prove needful in the Ritual Of Changing One’s Mind
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Solitary self-correction ritual contradicts evidence that effective debiasing is social or mechanical.
sharp_disagreements.gist: The Bardic Conspirator supplied the adversarial challenge first; the white room is solitary evaluation with checklists.

sharp_disagreements.title: You Can Face Reality
sharp_disagreements.quote: People can stand what is true,for they are already enduring it.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Unknown truths aren't already endured; Huntington's testing avoidance is rational (Golman et al. 2017).
sharp_disagreements.gist: Wiggins et al. 1992: learning Huntington's status improved well-being versus remaining uncertain.

sharp_disagreements.title: Burdensome Details
sharp_disagreements.quote: feel every added detail as a burden, even a single extra roll of the dice
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Penalizing every detail prefers vague theories to precise ones, ignoring Popper's content-probability trade.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Lower probability of specific claims is not preferring vagueness; only narrative appeal is penalized.

sharp_disagreements.title: Expecting Short Inferential Distances
sharp_disagreements.quote: the legendary difficulty most scientists have in communicating with a lay audience
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Essay's diagnosis is the deficit model, which failed; knowledge weakly predicts attitudes and polarizes.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay includes scientist-to-scientist explanation; Fable conflates persuasion with understanding.

sharp_disagreements.title: Feeling Rational
sharp_disagreements.quote: My sadness on waking is rational; there is no truth which destroys it.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: True-belief criterion cannot classify fiction-grief, moods, or phobias; epistemology does not do its work.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Passage identifies one rational sadness case; imagined-scenario responses fit; taxonomy incomplete, not contradictory.

sharp_disagreements.title: Planning Fallacy
sharp_disagreements.quote: But experiment has shown that the more detailed subjects’ visualization, the more optimistic (and less accurate) they become.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Detailed planning makes forecasts optimistic but speeds completion (implementation intentions); essay conflates prediction and performance.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Plans can aid execution while forecasts stay optimistic; Fable's distinction supports doing both.

sharp_disagreements.title: Planning Fallacy
sharp_disagreements.quote: Are they symptoms of bureaucracy or government incentive failures? Yes, very probably.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Flyvbjerg's non-improving overruns fit strategic misrepresentation; lab result explains students, not airports.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay explicitly distinguishes incentives from lab optimism; aggregate persistence doesn't identify cause.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Lens That Sees Its Own Flaws
sharp_disagreements.quote: Pondering this business of “performing replicable experiments to falsify theories,” we can see why it works.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Naive falsificationism misdescribes science (Lakatos) and contradicts the sequence's later rejection of it.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Endorsing replicable tests doesn't commit to naive falsificationism; later demands supplement, not contradict.

sharp_disagreements.title: What Do I Mean By “Rationality”?
sharp_disagreements.quote: No one can actually calculate and obey the math, any more than you can predict the stock market by calculating the movements of quarks.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Unattainable norm makes 'bias' uninformative; ecological rationality shows heuristics often outperform; bounded norm unasked.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Unattainable optimum still identifies remediable losses; following paragraph makes human methods the project.

sharp_disagreements.title: Why Truth? And…
sharp_disagreements.quote: it has a special and admirable purity
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Curiosity has documented biases toward near-answered and useless questions; its 'purity' lacks external check.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Choosing questions differs from accepting answers; essay itself flags curiosity's verification gap.

sharp_disagreements.title: … What’s a Bias, Again?
sharp_disagreements.quote: for example, the machinery to win arguments in adaptive political contexts
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Mercier & Sperber's argumentative theory develops the guess but implies social, not solitary, correction.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Reflective individuals can deliberately arrange disagreement; social and individual correction are compatible.

sharp_disagreements.title: A Fable of Science and Politics
sharp_disagreements.quote: Now history branches, depending on which member of the sightseeing party decided to follow the corridor to the surface.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Backfire effect failed to replicate; people update facts but attitudes stay; one fact doesn't hold up coalitions.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Neither Aditya nor Barron depicts backfire; endings dramatize reactions to the same observation.

sharp_disagreements.title: A Fable of Science and Politics
sharp_disagreements.quote: Ferris gasped involuntarily, frozen by sheer wonder and delight.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Hero Ferris has no stakes; fable exempts its model rationalist from the actual difficulty.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Daria acknowledges error despite social loss, countering the claim that rationality requires no stakes.

sharp_disagreements.title: Applause Lights
sharp_disagreements.quote: Since the reversal sounds abnormal, the unreversed statement is probably normal, implying it does not convey new information.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Reversal test is Grice's quantity maxim; flags sincere commitments as vacuous; name collides with Bostrom & Ord.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay lists legitimate uses and conditions diagnosis on lacking specifics; torture example fits its exception.

sharp_disagreements.title: Belief in Belief
sharp_disagreements.quote: you may remember a time period when you first began to doubt Santa Claus’s existence, but you still believed that you were supposed to believe in Santa Claus, so you tried to deny the doubts
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Children drop Santa through evidence and are fine; personal memory presented as developmental universal.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Sentence is a conditional invitation; Fable lacks prevalence data to refute it.

sharp_disagreements.title: Belief in Belief
sharp_disagreements.quote: the dragon-claimant anticipates as if there is no dragon in their garage, and makes excuses as if they believed in the belief
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Holding natural and supernatural explanations together is the cross-cultural default, not a pathology.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Commonness isn't epistemic success; question is whether avowals stay answerable to evidence.

sharp_disagreements.title: Making Beliefs Pay Rent (in Anticipated Experiences)
sharp_disagreements.quote: they do not anticipate any different experiences
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Essay uses verificationism selectively, with no rule separating legitimate from illegitimate unobservables.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Tree dispute is diagnosable as verbal without universal verificationism; essay permits indirect connections.

sharp_disagreements.title: Making Beliefs Pay Rent (in Anticipated Experiences)
sharp_disagreements.quote: If a belief turns deadbeat, evict it.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Duhem-Quine: failed predictions don't identify the deadbeat belief; Le Verrier's move resembles the dragon's.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Predictive auxiliary hypotheses are distinguishable in advance from excuses that remove observable effects.

sharp_disagreements.title: Making Beliefs Pay Rent (in Anticipated Experiences)
sharp_disagreements.quote: so you can regurgitate it on the upcoming quiz
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Floating belief is a rote-learning problem found in physics too; invented example unfairly targets humanities.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Rote physics is the subject of Guessing the Teacher's Password; fiction illustrates a general failure.

sharp_disagreements.title: Pretending to be Wise
sharp_disagreements.quote: Of course it matters who started the fight.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Principal's rule is sensible mechanism design when initiation is unverifiable; law also cares who ended it.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Enforceable fight rule doesn't make initiation irrelevant; essay allows principal to admit ignorance.

sharp_disagreements.title: Pretending to be Wise
sharp_disagreements.quote: neutrality is a definite judgment
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Tetlock's hedging foxes beat confident hedgehogs; calibrated non-commitment is not a pose.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Example asserts evidence is balanced; calibrated estimates are judgments, not refusals.

sharp_disagreements.title: Professing and Cheering
sharp_disagreements.quote: But even the concept of “religious profession” doesn’t seem to cover the pagan woman’s claim to believe in the primordial cow.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Pagan ethnography already covers symbolic belief; armchair taxonomy fails real religious people.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Adding a category for symbolic religious use improves rather than falsifies the taxonomy.

sharp_disagreements.title: Religion’s Claim to be Non-Disprovable
sharp_disagreements.quote: Ethics is what’s left.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Secularization thesis abandoned by its proponents; essay also contradicts itself on majority belief.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Passage describes a proposal the essay distances itself from; alleged contradiction fails, history needs support.

sharp_disagreements.title: Conservation of Expected Evidence
sharp_disagreements.quote: You needn’t bother planning how to make any given iota of evidence confirm your theory
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Positive test strategy is often efficient (Klayman & Ha); theorem leaves search strategy open.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Fable reverses the subset case in Klayman & Ha; diagnostic testing differs from confirming interpretation.

sharp_disagreements.title: Focus Your Uncertainty
sharp_disagreements.quote: it seems unlikely that bond prices will remain the same
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Bonds move on unexpected components; forecasters can't beat no-change, so the parable's judgment is wrong.
sharp_disagreements.gist: No-change point forecasts don't imply high probability of exactly no change; Fable's evidence doesn't fit.

sharp_disagreements.title: Hindsight Devalues Science
sharp_disagreements.quote: We need to make a conscious effort to be shocked enough.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Surprising findings replicate least; calibrated response to shocking results is skepticism, not more shock.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Noticing surprise differs from credulity; skepticism about surprising findings requires preserving surprise.

sharp_disagreements.title: How Much Evidence Does It Take?
sharp_disagreements.quote: Suppose you can use another black box to test combinations twice, independently.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Multiplying likelihood ratios needs independence rarely met; Sally Clark shows the danger.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay states independence repeatedly; extension is to use conditional likelihood ratios for dependent evidence.

sharp_disagreements.title: Occam’s Razor
sharp_disagreements.quote: It’s enormously easier (as it turns out) to write a computer program that simulates Maxwell’s equations, compared to a computer program that simulates an intelligent emotional mind like Thor.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Transformers are short code; for single events both theories are dominated by boundary conditions.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Initial conditions can be integrated out; fair comparison must charge both models, which neither side does.

sharp_disagreements.title: Scientific Evidence, Legal Evidence, Rational Evidence
sharp_disagreements.quote: Science is the publicly reproducible knowledge of humankind.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Most science never reproduced; replication crisis shows science runs on trust like history.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Failed replications show institutional gaps, not that reproducibility is the wrong aspiration.

sharp_disagreements.title: Scientific Evidence, Legal Evidence, Rational Evidence
sharp_disagreements.quote: only open knowledge counts as the public, reproducible knowledge pool of humankind
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Open access was enacted but reliability tracks methods, not access; predatory journals followed.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Access enables scrutiny without guaranteeing reliability; Fable hasn't isolated access's causal effect.

sharp_disagreements.title: What Is Evidence?
sharp_disagreements.quote: There has to be Shannon mutual information between the evidential event and the target of inquiry
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Mutual information is the wrong quantity; single-event evidence is the likelihood ratio.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Positive mutual information is necessary for any update; sentence states only the necessary condition.

sharp_disagreements.title: What Is Evidence?
sharp_disagreements.quote: a belief is only really worthwhile if you could, in principle, be persuaded to believe otherwise
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Principle as stated disqualifies arithmetic and itself; defends only empirical revisability.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Fallible agents' beliefs about theorems are revisable; revisability isn't instability.

sharp_disagreements.title: What Is Evidence?
sharp_disagreements.quote: that you believe for private reasons which are not transmissible
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Tacit expert knowledge is entangled but non-transmissible; essay can't separate it from floating belief.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Fable confuses transmitting evidence with transmitting know-how; visit shows skill was communicable.

sharp_disagreements.title: Explain/Worship/Ignore?
sharp_disagreements.quote: There—I just hit Worship.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Agrippa's trilemma: every explanatory chain ends somewhere; taxonomy brands all coherent stopping points as bad.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Worship is the added claim of ultimate-only explanation; essay permits postponing questions.

sharp_disagreements.title: Failing to Learn from History
sharp_disagreements.quote: Only then did I realize how reasonable vitalism had seemed at the time
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Contradicts earlier essay calling vitalists proud of ignorance; this essay quietly retracts it.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Seeming reasonable and being defective are compatible; earlier mind-reading needs qualification.

sharp_disagreements.title: Fake Explanations
sharp_disagreements.quote: It is anticipation-isomorphic to saying “magic.”
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Heat conduction is false, not empty; essay conflates falsified hypotheses with maximum-entropy ones.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay targets conduction used without constraints; bare utterance lacks boundary conditions to be falsified.

sharp_disagreements.title: Guessing the Teacher’s Password
sharp_disagreements.quote: putting in numbers and getting out results that control your anticipation of particular experiences
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Physics-education research: plugging numbers in coexists with conceptual misunderstanding; wrong criterion.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Criterion is anticipation control, and essay accepts qualitative images; Fable's students not counterexamples.

sharp_disagreements.title: Lawful Uncertainty
sharp_disagreements.quote: Despite feedback through a thousand trials, subjects cannot bring themselves to believe that the situation is one in which they cannot predict.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: With incentives most subjects converge to maximizing; matching is a defensible pattern-detection strategy.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Essay permits hypothesis generation while betting blue; revealed card gives same info whatever the bet.

sharp_disagreements.title: Mysterious Answers to Mysterious Questions
sharp_disagreements.quote: In a comedy written by Moliére
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Dormitive virtue locates cause in the opium, excluding alternatives; dispositional explanations aren't vacuous.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Redescription adds nothing once disposition is known; Fable shifts the question to cause discovery.

sharp_disagreements.title: Say Not “Complexity”
sharp_disagreements.quote: advocating that the Internet would “wake up” and become an AI when it became “sufficiently complex.”
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Scaling generic architectures on Internet text produced intelligence-like behavior without a worked-out mechanism.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Kaplan et al. concerns specified trained models, not arbitrary complexity; complexity leaves everything unspecified.

sharp_disagreements.title: Say Not “Complexity”
sharp_disagreements.quote: That was when I thought to myself, “Maybe this one is teachable.”
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Student repeating "emergence" is guessing the teacher's password, the test the sequence condemns.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Marcello's shift to demanding a mechanism is the evidence; teachability still needs a performance test.

sharp_disagreements.title: Semantic Stopsigns
sharp_disagreements.quote: How well have liberal democracies performed, historically, on problems this tricky?
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Liberal democracies have a strong record (Sen, Acemoglu); diagnostic can't tell compression from stopped thinking.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Good average record doesn't specify how democracy handles novel risks; the question stays legitimate.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Futility of Emergence
sharp_disagreements.quote: Human intelligence is a magical product of neurons firing.
sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: Emergent and magical license different inferences; substitution test uses sentences chosen to be empty.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Bare word does not entail Fable's added properties; stating them is repair, not proof of original content.

sharp_disagreements.title: The Futility of Emergence

sharp_disagreements.fable_gist: LLM 'emergent abilities' became a falsifiable technical claim, contradicting the prediction that emergence is only a curiosity-stopper.
sharp_disagreements.gist: Wei and Schaeffer dispute has content beyond the word; Fable overstates the essay as a prediction.
